items.title: Al Chez interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, February 13, 2019
items.q: But you know some of the stuff that he had — like Martin Short would come on, okay we’re going to write an original song.

ctx.x: Yeah. We’d be discussing that. We started off, I’ll tell you, we had a bunch of these little conversations going on. Like guys would come on and we’d hit the switch and we’d talk and we’d go, “Is that a hair piece? Is that guy wearing a wig?” And what we didn’t know is that the producers of the show were listening to us. So like two weeks after that they would do a bit on the show called “Hair Piece or Not a Hair Piece” and they stole it from our conversation, and it would be like, and they’d bring a guy out and…
just like write this music to it. So it was a tough job for him you know. I would never want that. Just playing trumpet was enough for me.
